instruction: ROOT CAUSE (owner-confirmed repro): fast-battle checked at launch -> encounters die (even at a good spot). FIX (F0 port of launcher setBattleEnd tcpserver.cpp 8138-8143, same context = B_recv case 'C' isEnemyAllDead): on battle-end in fast-battle send lssproto_EO_send(sockfd,0) @0x4B5630, gated on g_fbLogEn (auto-battle sends its own EO; double = units break). PS1 already patched (FastBattleEOSync cycle187). Step0 kill SA93Client + archive C:/zmffk/*diag*.log -> archive-pre187. Build (verify FastBattleEOSync marker + gates). Config FastBattle=true AutoBattle=false FastAutoWalk=true AutoWalk=false Boost=14. Launch ONE via '?앷린 ?ㅽ뻾'(1443,674), record RUN_SINCE_ISO. Observe ~120s; capture launcher F5->'諛고? ?곹솴' TAB screenshot (NOT general tab) cycle187-battlestatus.png during battle. Run assert-fastbattle186.ps1. Report EN count(>=3?), fastenc cnt, fn1/fn4909D0, FBCHAN, exp-result, sa.dmp fresh?, assert exit, screenshot. No commit.
